name: Sunday Rainforest Chiangmai Hotel
detail: we just like to share our experience at the Rainforest Hotel in chiang mai. We had really a wonderfull time, when we arrived late the hotel staff was very helpful to check us in and they had a welcome drink for us. We felt very welcome. Hotel is located a bit outside city center, but it was not a weak point. Hotel was easily accessible via tuk-tukk or taxi, and the Hotel offered at 7:00 o clock a free transfer in the evening to the local night bazaar and night market in chiang mai, the night market was very nice with a wide selection of stands, where you can buy all kind of things for a very good price. Next morning we had a very nice breakfast with a wide selection of fresh fruits, toast and everything you wish, it was excellent. Pool area was very nice too, we spend a afternoon at the pool and it was really nice and relaxing. Hotel staff was extremely helpful and we felt very welcome all the time.

name: Art Mai Gallery Nimman Hotel Chiang Mai
detail: The Art Mai Gallery Nimman Hotel is located a block from Nimmanhaemin Road in Chiang Mai, a short drive from the airport. The area features many restaurants and shops. The Maya Shopping Center is a short walk away. Our room at the third floor, which featured Pop Art, was compact but adequately sized and very comfortable. The bathroom was well designed and relatively large. The room was excellently soundproofed. Despite looking out at the road, we heard almost no street noise. The staff was warm and welcoming. The front desk was well organized and easily able to answer our questions. The restaurant staff did an excellent job handling the busy morning buffet breakfast. Rather than have egg dishes on the buffet, servers take orders and have them individually prepared. We enjoyed viewing the paintings in the art gallery. Our friends in Chiang Mai had no problem finding the hotel. However, it is a 15 to 20 minute ride by tuk-tuk into the center of the old town where many of the temples and museums are located. Nonetheless, we would recommend this well-run hotel to friends, especially if they wish to stay near Nimmanhaemin Road or Chiang Mai University.

name: Hostel Lullaby
detail: It was the best place of my travel. Now I love Chiang Mai and I love Lullaby hostel. The hostel was so very clean, the staff is super nice et increasing. The is very secure et the dorm is very clean. It’s the good place where you meet another travellers. In the price you have a good breakfast, yoga class and cooking class. If I come back in Chiang Mai it’s for sur to come back at this place. Peace ☮️

name: Nature Boutique Hotel at Chiangmai
detail: I stayed in a dorm under the roof. The dorm has 2 AC and a washbin. Outside the dorm is the shared toilet and bathroom. The locker for the luggage are to small to put a back pack inside. It's just for your valuables. Everything was very clean. You get a blanket and a pillow but no towel. At the terrace you have a wunderful view over Chiang Mai. Nearby is the somphet market and many temples. It's no problem to find breakfast in the surrounding.

detail: We booked 3 nights in this hotel but decided to stay for 7 nights because we really liked it. The location next to the river is beautifull and the staff is really friendly and helpfull. name: ibis Styles Chiang Mai
detail: Actually I and my friend had another reservation at other hotel quite out of town, but we decided to extend our journey in Chiang Mai so I looked up at agoda and found this great deal of All Seasons Chiang Mai (its name as of July 2012). We arrived the hotel around 9am on a Saturday, and there was room available for us. No wait! Wonderful! Unfortunately, our local friend who drove us to the hotel got a little accident with his finger in front of the hotel so Khun K, the concierge, who was at the entrance immediately brought a first aid box and helped my friend. That was so nice of him. Anyway, once we checked-in our room, I found that it was quite a big room, bright and nice. The beds were comfy, the bathroom was fine with toiletries (no bath tub). The hotel gave us WiFi password along with the key card so Internet is accessible in room. At the lobby, there was a corner providing cold water and herbal drink and something for nibble (cookies) which were very nice. We have tried cold Lemon grass drink, Bael fruit drink, and Chrysanthemum drink. All were very refreshing! There are also Internet corner (I think it's free) near the Front desk too. The breakfast was fine. There were eggs, ham, sausages. Thai style rice soup, fried rice, and fried noodles. Fresh fruits, corn flakes, fruit juice, milk, coffee & tea were also available at the buffet. Waiter Khun Doi was giving us a very friendly service that morning. There is a 7-Eleven just round the corner (back of the hotel). The hotel is near Huay Kaew road, not far from the old town and only minutes to Nimmanhemin road and Chiang Mai university. I was very much impressed by the hotel staff from Front office to Concierge, to Restaurant. They always smile and are very friendly and happy to help us in anything. I think this is a strong point for the hotel. I would definitely come back to All Seasons Chiang Mai, perhaps next time there name would be renamed to Ibis Styles already.
